voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: Humahamog ang salamin ng kabaong. Mula sa loob.
lines.beat_before: hook: the glass window of the coffin, from above; it fogs from the inside; then four finger streaks

lines.text: Bakit tayo nagpupuyat sa lamay? Sabi ng matatanda, para bantayan ang bangkay.
lines.beat_before: 9 p.m.: the wake, full: cards, chairs, candles, the covered mirror

lines.text: Dahil noon, may mga nilalang na kumukuha ng patay.
lines.beat_before: 11 p.m.: fewer people; the candles lean toward the coffin

lines.text: Sa mga kuwento sa Kabisayaan, may amalanhig. Bangkay na bumabangon.
Matigas ang katawan. Hindi makabaluktot. Kaya diretso lang itong maglakad, pero mabilis.
lines.beat_before: 2 a.m.: the cloth slides off the mirror; in the mirror the coffin lid is open; in the room it is shut

lines.text: Kapag hinabol ka raw, tumakbo ka nang paliko-liko.
lines.beat_before: 3 a.m.: the clock; beside the coffin the body is standing

lines.text: Alas tres na. Tulog na ang lahat ng nagbabantay.
lines.beat_before: from above: the chase; you run zigzag through the chairs; it goes straight, slamming through them
